reviews.text: My dog was well taken care of. He left happy and spotless wearing the most adorable bandana complementary of the team. We plan on returning.

I have a 7 month old puppy who is afraid of baths. We signed up for the club to get him used to grooming. After the first bath they said he did well but recommended he get trimmed to address the matts that he gets on his legs. I thought that would be fine. Fast forward to this month ... I spoke to the groomer Emily, about what we wanted and didn't want, specifically not a full cut only what was necessary because he is nervous. She said she understood, felt his face etc and said they would just trim his legs and possibly where his harness might create problems. When I picked up Linus he was completely shaved and is now so uncomfortable he is hiding in our house.
The point was to get him used to bathing & grooming not freak him out! You cannot trust that this location will do what they tell you!! Beware, you might get a shaved pup that you didn't ask for!

We’ve been going for a few months now with our puppy and it’s been great. I like the balance between having them do the washes, cleanings, trimming etc and then allowing us to use their space for our own washes. Their setup is perfect for animals whereas our bathtub at home is a disaster. We can do the washes ourselves in about 30 minutes and leave with a clean pup and no mess.

We had such a great experience at Bowie Barker! My golden, Benson, can be a little nervous about grooming and he also had quite a bit of matting that needed attention. The team was so patient, professional, and knowledgeable throughout the whole process. Nelly and Delaney really took the time to understand him and meet him where he was. The space was also extremely clean and well kept.

Benson has never felt so silky or smelled so good, but most importantly, he was HAPPY. He was excited from the moment we arrived and just as happy when I picked him up. I’m so thrilled to have found a place where the staff genuinely cares about each pup and their individual needs. We’re so excited to be monthly members!

We talked to 2 different people before bringing our dog in to have a nail trim asking if the could take care of an anxious dog and were assured yes they could. We asked if we needed to medicate our dog and were assured they handle anxious dogs all the time no medication necessary. We added a bath service to the nail trim. $85 charge for a bath and they were unable to provide the most needed part, the nail trim service. It took 3 people to do the bath, and not one could trim her nails. They would not refund nor did they seem to believe me when I said their staff told us our dog didn't need medication because they handle anxious dogs all the time. I explained all of this to the manager and regional manager. When I spoke to the regional manager she was not warm and understanding. I asked the regional manager to have the branch owner call me and he never bothered. They did say we could bring our dog back for a free nail trim (that we paid for already) but she is too scared to go back there.  They do not do well with anxious dogs. If you have an anxious dog please go somewhere else.
Thanks! We appreciate the feedback and are looking forward to seeing you at our shop again soon.  We are here for you and your pup ALWAYS!  Bowie Barker Lincoln Park

Great self wash station. Staff are friendly and helpful.

Shampoo, conditioner, towels, and a high velocity dryer are all available for use and very helpful. They also have cotton balls with ear cleaner and brushes available for use.

This was our first time at Bowie Barker and they did such a great job with our Samoyed. We brought our dog to them after a catastrophic experience at another local groomer. They were very communicative, clearly understood the breed, did a great job rehabbing her coat, and most importantly looked out for her comfort and well-being throughout the experience (which was long given the need to attend to the problems caused by the prior groomer)!

My family and I live near the Lincoln Park store and we have been customers for over a year.  The past ~45 days the front desk service has declined to the point that I’m canceling my membership and shifting my business to Krisers.
Note to the franchise owner;  allowing your staff to set arbitrary hours is not customer friendly and makes for unnecessarily difficult phone conversations and long on hold wait times while “the off duty manager’s opinion is being sought”.
Expensive but they do a fantastic job and so worth it! George always looks so fluffy after a trip to Bowie barker
Best around! Amazing staff and groomers. Wouldn’t trust my dog with anybody else Piper loves her groomer Alex!!!
Today was the second time I had my dog bathed, etc.  I think she did great and I'm very happy!

Hi Doug,

Thank you for the 5 star review and for trusting Bowie Barker Lincoln Park with your pup. We appreciate you being part of the pack and are glad you had a great experience with us.

Looking forward to seeing you both again soon!

-The Bowie Barker Team
We love going to Bowie Barker! Piper always looks amazing
Great experience! They make our pup feel so comfortable and she always comes away looking great!
Brought my Bernice puppy in for her first bath. Everyone at Bowie was awesome to her, she looked amazing and seemed to have a really good/fun time there.

We have been taking our little pup Marshal to Bowie Barker for 4 months now with their monthly membership. The staff has always been so nice, accommodating, and sweet not only to us but to Marshal as well. He recognizes the walk over and gets excited every time we go, and he gets a cute bandana with the season! The staff sends update photos while he’s getting his bath, which is always appreciated. 10/10 would recommend, so happy Bowie is in our neighborhood!

Henry is ready for spring with his new haircut!   We’ve been going to Bowie Barker for almost a year & wish we had started sooner!   The grooming is always great, scheduling is easy & everyone is so nice!  (The cute picture they send when he is getting a bath is an adorable bonus!)
The staff are always so kind and they treat my nervous dog with care and love!
We have two Frenchies and have really enjoyed every aspect of our experience at Bowie Barker in Lincoln Park!

Hi Julie,

Thank you so much for the 5-star review! We truly appreciate you taking the time to share your experience with our Lincoln Park shop.

Our team is committed to delivering the best in care for every pup that walks through our doors, and it means a lot to know we hit the mark with you.

We look forward to seeing you and your pup again soon!

🐾The Bowie Barker Team
Great service and caring staff. They take great care of our pup.
They always take such good care of Duke and send me the cutest pictures of him while getting a bath! Highly recommend this place!
Great experience! My Shih Tzu mix had a bath and haircut. He looked great.

I have a rescue with some trust and anger management issues. So getting him groomed is always a bit of tricky thing. They were so welcoming and accommodating. I could tell they were the right place just from my emails to them alone. They were able to handle my boy and clean him up real good. They earned a returning customer.

I dropped my dog off for grooming and two hours later she was all set.  Most significantly, she was happy!  I've always had such a hard time trying to bathe her myself/cut her nails.  Bowie Barker is a Godsend!
Bowie Barker, kudos to Candace and the whole team, you pampered my pup and she has never looked or smelled better! Join the club and you’ll appreciate the savings and the results.

Bowie Barker is a wonderful place. Our rescues are new to them after several rough experiences at Krisers in Lincoln Park. They get our pups in and out and they truly care about the dogs. On our last visit they alerted us to a tumor that was being hidden by our dogs tail and his hair. We are beyond grateful for the discovery and for the love and care they give to all of dogs. Our dogs leave smelling clean and they look stunning after. It’s not an all day affair like other groomers. We appreciate well run the organization is and how much each groomer is professional, kind, and caring. We would recommend this company and location.

Candace always does a fantastic job grooming my mini Goldendoodle, Maisey! The entire BB staff is incredibly kind and patient. Maisey has had some behavioral challenges in the past getting groomed, but they are always so caring and accommodating, and they really take the time to make her feel comfortable. It means a lot to know she’s in such good hands, because I always worry. I highly recommend Candace and the Bowie Barker team for anyone looking for a great dog groomer!
Bruce loves his monthly spa day! Thanks for making him feel calm, clean and full of treats!

Always a great experience, but we took our dog in recently who currently has mobility restrictions ahead of an upcoming surgery and they were super accommodating with allowing me to help with the bath portion and trim. Ashley is FANTASTIC and went the extra mile to make our dog feel comfortable and safe.

Hi Armando,

We are sorry to see this and would really appreciate the opportunity to connect and learn more about your experience. Please give our store a call at 312 931 8260 or email us at lincolnpark@bowiebarker.com so we can make this right.

The Bowie Barker Team

Extremely happy with my experiences at Bowie Barker! The staff is super welcoming and great at what they do. They make my sure my anxious dog, Atlas, feels safe and calm every time. He loves going each month!
Bowie Barker always does an AMAZING JOB!! From the front desk to the groomers, everyone is super friendly and accommodating!!
Thank you so much for the 5 stars, Gus! We truly appreciate you taking the time to support us and look forward to seeing you and your pup again soon. The Bowie Barker Team

This is our fourth or fifth time bringing our pup to Bowie, and he absolutely loves it! The staff is warm, professional, and clearly care about the dogs they work with. I always feel completely confident leaving him there, knowing he’s in great hands. One thing I really appreciate, especially compared to other groomers and big pet stores, is that my dog isn’t stuck waiting around for 4+ hours. The turnaround time is reasonable, and the photo updates they send are a thoughtful touch. It’s always reassuring (and fun!) to see how he’s doing.

We’ve had nothing but positive experiences here and couldn’t be happier. Highly recommend!

We’ve been taking our two Golden Retrievers here and have had consistently great experiences. Everyone is so kind and patient, and they do an amazing job—clean, fluffy, perfectly trimmed, and always happy when we pick them up. You can tell they truly care about the dogs. We wouldn’t go anywhere else!

We’ve been coming to Bowie for almost a year now and they do a great job! They always make us feel safe and take great care of Roger.  I love that they send us progress pictures and updates on how he’s doing. After having a terrible experience at another groomer, the staff goes above and beyond to spend extra time around Roger’s eyes since he’s overly sensitive. They have the best treats as well!

Hi Eva,

Thank you so much for the five star review. We truly appreciate you taking the time to share your support for our Lincoln Park shop. It means a lot to our team.

We look forward to seeing you and your pup again soon!

-The Bowie Barker Team

Thank you so much, Maria! We appreciate the five stars and are glad you had a great experience at Bowie Barker Lincoln Park. We look forward to welcoming you and your pup back again soon.

-The Bowie Barker Team
The best! Everyone is so friendly and warm and my dog always looks amazing afterwards!
They did any amazing job.

Amazing.  After every visit, my dog leaves HAPPY and CLEAN!!!!
Thank u Bowie Barker
❤️

Bowie Barker does a great job with our doodle mix! He’s been going here for over a year now and all the groomers and staff are great. They’re willing to work with him and his anxiety and have great treats.
They are fabulous with dogs and the grooming is soooo good- he looks like a movie star dog every time!!!!
Easy to book on app, many open time slots within days, cost is reasonable and facility is very cute.  Friendly staff!  My dogs don’t hate it here 😂. Favorite part is the mid bath photos

Hi Nick, 
Thank you so much for the 5 star review! We’re thrilled you had a great experience at Bowie Barker Lincoln Park. Our team works hard to deliver top tier care in a clean, welcoming space, and feedback like this lets us know we’re hitting the mark. We appreciate you being part of the pack and look forward to seeing you again soon!

The Bowie Barker Team
Amazing, caring team! Our puppy loved it and well for sure be back!

My dog looks so nice and grace was sp nice and beautiful

My dog, Halo, absolutely loves going to Bowie Barker in Lincoln Park! The moment we get close, her tail starts wagging like crazy because she knows she’s about to be pampered. The staff is incredibly kind, patient, and genuinely caring—Halo always comes out looking adorable, smelling amazing, and most importantly, happy.

The groomers take their time to make sure she’s comfortable, and they always listen to any special requests. The entire experience is smooth, professional, and full of good vibes. I can’t imagine taking Halo anywhere else. Highly recommend Bowie Barker Lincoln Park to anyone who wants their pup treated like family!

Ps she loves the treats and the treat dispenser out front when the salon is closed!

Another amazing full groom for Sienna at Bowie Barker Lincoln Park. She’s looking extra cute thanks to Ashley! The groomers are pros and know how to make every pup look and feel their best!  From groomers to front desk staff, everyone is so warm and caring with all the pups! If you're not taking your pup to Bowie Barker Lincoln Park (South Loop location now open too), you and your pup are missing out!
Wonderful! The Bowie Barker stylists take such good care of my dog. They are patient getting out mats, and she always comes out smelling and looking great.

THE BEST DOODLE SALON IN CHICAGO. They specialize in doodle haircuts although offer so many great services. Amazing pricing compared to other corporate dog barbers, and a very knowledgeable, and talented staff. I was so happy after my first visit that I immediately signed up for their membership program. Highly recommend!!!

We’re new to Lincoln Park. Easy to make (and reschedule) our grooming appointment. Friendly staff. Quick and timely groom. Love the progress shot we received during the bath. My dog looks fantastic. Easy peasy!
They do such a great job with the grooms and also calming down my groom-anxious dog. Highly recommend Nelly for her calming presence and great cuts!
Easy to get a last minute appointment with caring pros
They’re wonderful!
Mickey loves this place and they love her!
Nelly is the absolute best! She is is patient with kiwi and she has made kiwi’s experience at Bowie Barker great!
The crew was great with Milo and his coat looked fantastic after his grooming.  This was our second visit and they did a great job both times.  We will be back again soon!

The staff greets you warmly and takes time to understand your pet’s specific needs and personality. The groomers are patient, skilled, and incredibly gentle — making even the most anxious pets feel at ease. The results always exceed expectations, with every pup leaving looking clean, well-groomed, and happy. The space itself is modern, bright, and impeccably maintained, creating a welcoming environment for both pets and owners.

What really makes Bowie Barker special is the level of care and attention to detail they bring to every visit. They clearly value building trust with their clients and ensuring that each pet has a positive, stress-free experience. The team communicates well, offers great advice on maintenance between appointments, and treats every dog as if it were their own. Whether you’re bringing your pet in for a simple bath or a full spa treatment, Bowie Barker delivers consistent quality and compassion
Amazing work!!!

Extremely happy with our experiences at Bowie! The DIY bathtubs are so convenient. Our first monthly wash, ears, nails and teeth was amazing! Our stylist listen to our concerns, areas to avoid and sent an update during. We will be continuing with our monthly membership!
Everyone is so nice and accommodating!  So happy to have Murphy in such trusting hands!

The team at Bowie Barker is always professional, friendly, and clearly cares about the dogs they work with. They do a great job keeping Ravioli looking his best and even handle nail trims with ease, despite his usual resistance. It’s a pleasure supporting such a dependable local business.
My sweet Hazel loves Bowie Barker!
Loved my girls haircuts!! They also send picture updates which is cool for the helicopter dog moms lol

Hi Alexandra,

Thank you so much for the 5 stars. We’re thrilled to hear you and your pup had a great experience with us at Bowie Barker – Lincoln Park. We can’t wait to welcome you both back soon!

Lisa 🐾
Regional Manager, Bowie Barker

First time trying out Bowie Baker and was pretty disappointed in my pup's first cut. The ears were not cut properly and honestly my dog looks like lord Farquaad from Shrek now. Staff is very friendly but wont be back based on the cut my pup received.
Everyone is lovely and our dog looks great!
I’m happy to have finally found a groomer who can work with a Puli. Great work and very professional.
This place is great.  Always so friendly when we come, Nelly is amazing for our Chipper.  Cheers to your year anniversary Bowie Barker

Hi Libby,

Thank you so much for the 5-star review! We’re thrilled to hear you had a great experience at Bowie Barker and look forward to seeing you and your pup again soon.

Lisa 🐾
Regional Manager, Bowie Barker

We love Bowie Barker!!! Our little guy Winston was always terrified to go to the groomers, so we made the change to Bowie and it is one of his favorite places to go now. The staff is always so sweet to him, his groomer Nelly always does such a good job and he always loves to see her. Would highly recommend

I've chosen to give two stars because although the haircut turned out nice, to cut a 10-pound dog 2 hours late, and for $200, we will be going elsewhere moving forward.

The primary issue was their scheduling. We had an appointment at 1PM. At 12:45, already on our way, they called to ask us if we could come in at 3PM to “accommodate another guest.” As this was a Saturday, we had already planned our day with a hard stop at 4PM, so we declined and dropped off our dog on time at 1 PM.  As we walked in, the other guest, presumably a monthly subscriber, stepped in with their dog; we suspect they moved the other dog ahead of us anyway.

When I picked up our dog at nearly 5PM, I explained calmly the situation and how they blew well past the original 2.5 - 3 hour time estimate; it had messed up our day. All the woman at the front desk had to say about it was, “Ok, awesome…so how would you like to pay?”. Realizing I was getting nowhere with her, I paid, tipped, and asked for the manager. Instead of giving me the manager's info, as she was off that day, she only wrote down the general email with no contact name, which made it more challenging to raise the issue with her supervisor.

While the haircut was nice, we had an appointment, so presumably they would have had enough groomers to match their scheduled volume. Still, they didn't, and on top of it, they moved someone in front of us, despite us declining their offer. For roughly  $200 to cut a 10-pound dog, 2 hours past their estimated 2.5 - 3 hour turnaround time is unacceptable. So, since they can't manage a schedule, and the woman at the front desk offered us no resolution for our time, we will go elsewhere moving forward, and I suggest you should too—bottomline, Bowie’s team gave our dog a 4-star haircut (but not so great it’s not achievable elsewhere, and at likely a far cheaper price), provided 1-star time management, and 1-star customer service. Overall, it was a 2-star experience
Bowie Barker on Lincoln Park did a great job on my dog’s grooming. They were organized, communicated, wanted to know about her needs for grooming, very happy!!

The groomers here are awesome with my pup! My husband and I have been coming since day one—Nelly (one of the groomers) told us she’d be working here when they opened, and we’ve been regulars ever since. Booking online is super easy, with add-ons and times laid out clearly. The place is always clean and well taken care of, and I love that they send pictures of my pup during his bath.
I take my puppy to Bowie Barker monthly. They do such a great job every time. I highly recommend.

Unfortunately my dog went for a bath and left without one of his toenails.  Trying to cancel membership since this is clearly unacceptable but they haven’t gotten around to getting back to me.  Save your money, it’s overpriced and I can’t guarantee your dog will be safe.
Amazing job and great communication! We will be back
This is such a great space! They do great work and my very nervous dog loves it there!
Thanks for the 5 stars, David! We appreciate you being part of the pack 🐾 - Bowie Barker Team …

Hi Paige, Thank you so much for the 5-star review! We’re thrilled to hear you (and your pup!) had a great experience with us. Our team works hard to make every visit feel easy, welcoming, and tail-waggingly wonderful — so your kind words mean a lot.

We can’t wait to see you both again soon! 🐾

– Lisa
Regional Manager, Bowie Barker

Bowie Barker is excellent! The staff is friendly, great with my dog and they do excellent work. The single ingredient treats (lamb!) are George’s favorite. Very easy to get a quick appointment if you need it…George likes to roll in stinky stuff. I appreciate everything they do and even better George loves his visits.

Bowie Barker is fantastic! They’re patient, professional, and clearly love what they do. My dogs came home clean, trimmed perfectly, and happy. Booking was easy, prices are fair, and the service is top-notch. Highly recommend!

They cut my dog's paw pad!!!!
The groomer kept saying no big deal.
This is incredibly frustrating and infuriating!!!
She should get fired!
Now my poor dog has to wear a cone for weeks!

They also did an awful job shaving her privates.

6 years of grooming and this was the worst experience!

My goldendoodle has really long hair so we are very particular with where he gets groomed. First time going to Bowie Barker in Lincoln Park and will not be our last. Kelly was amazing and Napa was so floofy!
Took their time with our 16 year old dog and we’re so sweet and thoughtful. Immediately signed up for the monthly membership!
They were very timely unprofessional, and my dog was happy when she left! They did a great job!

Thank you so much to Jesse for your hard work on our dog, Casper! We are so happy with his cut and can already tell he is way more comfortable for the upcoming hot weather. The extra time you spent is so greatly appreciated!

The place is very clean, the staff is extremely personable, Lizette listened to exactly what I wanted for my dog in terms of length ect. She was very patient. I will definitely book her again. I am very happy with the place.
Exactly what my dog with separation anxiety needed!  So great❤️

I have been going to Bowie Barker every two weeks for a bath and occasional trim of her bum and paws, and have overall been very pleased until yesterday where my dog received a beyond terrible haircut.

In the written notes, I put down that I wanted her trimmed, kept fluffy, and no razoring around the face or body. I reiterated this to the groomer Trent in person, and he did the exact opposite.

The entire cut is uneven, but what I’m most devastated about is her face. Trent clearly electric razored around her face and it is uneven, sparse, and unblended. He also chopped off her left eyelashes (right ones are still long and intact). Her body is much shorter than what asked for. He basically shaved her, which I asked him not to.

In addition to the awful haircut, Trent was rude and did not seem to care or have any interest in what I wanted my dog to look like. Overall, it was clear he just wanted to be done as quickly as possible and did not care about the quality of his work.

I was refunded and offered a credit when I called and told them how disappointed I was, but that is definitely not enough to make up for the terrible job and months it’s going to take to regrow her once beautiful face and coat.

Bowie Barker did SUCH a great job grooming my 5 month old Bernese Mountain Dog puppy! The staff was incredibly kind and welcoming and I love that they sent me updates and pictures throughout the process. We will absolutely continue using them for all grooming needs in the future!

It’s so nice having a new groomer in Lincoln Park. Francisco did a great job on my boy! Definitely my new go to groomer.

UPDATE: I have been going here for months and have had great experiences, until recently when there was a mix-up in the charge for one of my dogs grooms. The regional manager reached out to me via email, and went above and beyond to rectify the situation. Honestly I couldn't be more pleased with the service here. Highly recommend!

They are absolutely fantastic and I’m so happy they’re in the neighborhood. Attentive, timely, and really caring when working with my dog. Will absolutely be continuing my membership and coming back monthly
Thank you so much for the 5 stars! We’re so glad you had a great experience and can’t wait to see you and your pup again soon.

We just finished our first visit after signing up for the membership and we’ll be coming back once a month forever! I’ll never take my dogs anywhere else again. Our two pups struggle with the groomer and they really made it easy here. We picked the dogs up and I could tell they were happy and had fun! Everyone at the desk was kind and informative. If you love your dogs, bring them here! Oh and they send you pics for updates during-precious

I had heard from others how great Bowie Barker was for their dog and I figured it was worth a try, the hype is real! All of the staff were extremely nice and you could tell they genuinely care for your pets.

I booked a bath, seasonal glow up, and haircut for my doodle and he came out so clean, smelled AMAZING and the cut was exactly what I was looking for. They also sent pictures of him throughout his time there which was a nice touch.

They also offer a DIY dog bath which is great for in between groomings and have a wall of treats of all types for the pups with great pricing.

Overall, 12/10 would recommend!

My pup (who absolutely DESPISES baths btw) had a great experience here! They were very patient with him, and even sent a progress photo midway through his bath. It's the small details that mean a lot, and I will absolutely be back. Thanks Bowie Barker!
I’m very pleased with the services Bowie Barker provided for my dog. I felt confident in leaving her with their kind staff, too.
Did an amazing job for Winston came in matted and in need of some tlc will definitely come back ❤️ Brandon Chrisman

This place is amazing left my brother’s dog max looking very sharp! They also have good treats for dogs and the workers are so nice to any dog that comes to the door they have allot of patience too if I could give them more then 5 stars I really would I will keep bringing my brothers dog here this place is the real deal ! Huge shoutout to Nelly for taking care of max your the best and your cool too well all the workers in there are very cool .. gave Nelly a nice big tip for her good work thanks me and max will see you guys soon my brother is probably gonna get the membership.

We recently had the pleasure of having  our very tiny 175 lb. St Bernard groomed.  He does not like baths never mind how they managed to lift him into the bath, I was amazed.  The staff was amazing and took great care of him from check in to the end when we picked him up.  He smells great and the groom itself is better than we expected. I had to wait for 2 college kids to be home to get him in the car so included them in the picture afterward.  Thank you, we will be back!
Awesome staff, and great service! My pup looked and smelled amazing after grooming!
Such a great service and Hosanna my cocker spaniel looked amazingly great !👍🏽 …
Thank you for your glowing review! We appreciate your business and can’t wait to see you back soon!
So amazing with our puppy. Introduced him slowly to grooming which was new for him. He looks amazing!!

Nails done, hair done, everything did!

It was my seven year old French’s first time at a professional groomer and I am blown away by Bowie Barker! Danette at the front desk warm and friendly. The staff won my pup over immediately and gave him a treat prior to his bath. I loved that they asked if he had any allergies or dietary restrictions first. We all know that French Bulldogs are extra sensitive!

I opted for a bath (includes ear cleaning, teeth cleaning, nail trim, AND blowout), and added on: deshedding, gland expression, hydrating treatment, and a specialty shampoo. Bowie Barker has so many great add on options; I wasn’t worried about their products irritating his sensitive skin.

I received a photo update from the team and a courtesy call to let me know when he’d be ready for pickup. Bathing my dog has always been a challenge for me but Rashad (bather) let me know that he did so well ☺️ I’ll leave it to the professionals moving forward.

We will definitely be back and I’m so glad to know that my pup was in great hands! Grooming can be a stressful experience for some dogs (and dog owners) but my pup Rambo left happy as can be. Thank you for taking care of my boy, Bowie Barker team!

They brought my lil guy back to life!

I love the fact that they took the time to shape his fur on his body and face instead of just cutting all his hair off with clippers. The groomer asked for reference photos and went over everything that they would be doing she was extremely informative and helpful.

I opted for the upgraded wash and cologne and he smells amazing!

10/10 would definitely be back 🤍

My boy looks so fresh! The groomers were very kind and loving with our Shih tzu.  Service was super quick too! He came out of the groom trimmed up and looking cute.  They listened to all of our needs and trimmed him up just how we wanted. Basically everyone you talk to is very nice and welcoming. Usually he is very nervous with groomers and getting his nails trimmed.  But here  he felt safe enough to allow them to.
Thank you!

They are so wonderful! we brought our old gal in and she got right along with Rashad and the rest of the crew! she’s an anxious doggie so it’s reassuring that they send a photo during each bath our dog gets so we see that she’s feeling comfortable and happy

If you want your pup to have a great experience at a groomers this is where you need to take them, not only will they have an amazing experience but you yourself will as well, the staff their was so wonderful, sometimes you wonder if there is anymore great customer service, 😊 😀 ☺️ Kendrix didn't even want to leave from their he just loved being loved, an amazing staff from the time you walk in to the time you walk out. Have to try this place you won't regret it

Before and after of my baby Hunter! 😍😍  Francisco did a wonderful job! Hunter was in need of a grooming and I am amazed by Francisco’s work! Highly recommend this groomer as the entire staff is super friendly and helpful. I will be returning! 😊 …
We greatly appreciate your 5 star review! Thank you for visiting Bowie Barker, we hope to see you back soon!
My dog smells so good and is so soft and fluffy! Trent did amazing I would definitely 10/10 recommend!
Ali was amazing with Sebastian. We love them and they’re very nice and accommodating.

If you are thinking about taking your pup here, I really recommend it! They took good care of my dog Kanelo. The staff was super sweet and gave Kanelo treats to make him feel comfortable. They took good care of him
and they took the time to explain things to us which we appreciated! Thank you guys!

I’m not generally a reviewer but had a great first experience with Bowie Barker and feel like it’s worth sharing. I have a 95lb shedding dog and they did an amazing job getting her cleaned up — washed, dried, trimmed fur and nails exactly as we discussed. Also, the ease of scheduling, location and staff are all fabulous. They had my dog in and out in a couple of hours and kept me updated during her appointment. Perhaps most importantly, the team was really sweet and put my dog at ease — she usually has anxiety at the groomer and did just fine!
Best place!
Great service! Great staff. Definitely will be back!
Great job on our little guy.
